propositions: Comments across 439 files in src/rebar were triaged against a destination taxonomy: history to tickets, architecture to ADRs, contracts to schema, with inline blocks carrying only proximate just-in-time context.
Self-referential prose explaining the 800-line file-size cap occupied the budget it documented; 28 reconciler sites contained variants of this pattern requiring removal or relocation.

Six verified-stale comments documented live invariants (deterministic floor discrepancies, Anthropic constraint relics, unimplemented stubs, import sequencing, and key-map omissions) requiring correction rather than deletion.

Load-bearing invariants and anti-refactor warnings were identified, recorded on do_not_move lists, and preserved verbatim (examples: DC 8.17.1 silent-ignore behavior, ACLI inverted flag semantics, exception header access patterns).
Eight sites contained the same four-paragraph idempotent-transform argument restated across the codebase, consolidated into a single ADR to collapse inline blocks to one-line citations.

Six shards completed in dependency order (changes 1542–1547), each measuring and recording actual recovered lines; net outcome was ~85 comment/docstring lines recovered across shards through relocation and deletion of non-load-bearing prose.
